'''Gord Madel''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Engineer/Legends|Engineer]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was working for the [[Nar Shaddaa Works Administration]] when he was approached by [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] with an order to detonate gas pipes running under the [[Meridian Hall]] to create an illusion of a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]. Madel initially tried to refuse, but was forced to comply with Kallig's orders.
